headline: Brazil Mandates Human Customer Service Options Under New Rules
summary: The Brazilian government enacted rules making human customer service mandatory for customer service operations, with abusive calls subject to penalties.
why: Stricter consumer protection mandates can increase operational overhead for customer-facing enterprises operating in Brazil.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Mandatory human customer service layers increase labor overhead for consumer-facing businesses.
